exercises.why: **сорок → сорока** — genitive, dative, instrumental and prepositional. Note that both parts of these four numerals (50, 60, 70, 80) are declined separately but are written together.
**пятьдесят → пятидесяти** — genitive, dative and prepositional. Note that both parts of these four numerals (50, 60, 70, 80) are declined separately but are written together.
**пятьдесят → пятьюдесятью** — instrumental. Note that both parts of these four numerals (50, 60, 70, 80) are declined separately but are written together.
**шестьдесят → шестидесяти** — genitive, dative and prepositional. Note that both parts of these four numerals (50, 60, 70, 80) are declined separately but are written together.
**шестьдесят → шестьюдесятью** — instrumental. Note that both parts of these four numerals (50, 60, 70, 80) are declined separately but are written together.
**семьдесят → семидесяти** — genitive, dative and prepositional. Note that both parts of these four numerals (50, 60, 70, 80) are declined separately but are written together.
**семьдесят → семьюдесятью** — instrumental. Note that both parts of these four numerals (50, 60, 70, 80) are declined separately but are written together.
**восемьдесят → восьмидесяти** — genitive, dative and prepositional. Note that both parts of these four numerals (50, 60, 70, 80) are declined separately but are written together.
**восемьдесят → восемьюдесятью** — instrumental. Note that both parts of these four numerals (50, 60, 70, 80) are declined separately but are written together.
**девяносто → девяноста** — genitive, dative, instrumental and prepositional. Note that both parts of these four numerals (50, 60, 70, 80) are declined separately but are written together.
**сто → ста** — genitive, dative, instrumental and prepositional. Note that both parts of these four numerals (50, 60, 70, 80) are declined separately but are written together.
